## Run complete — Backend CONVERGED (16th consecutive run, 0 bugs / 0 fixes)

**Precondition re-proven this run:** `git diff --stat 2d7fb57..HEAD -- server/src client/src` and `git status --porcelain -- server/src client/src` are both **EMPTY**. Every commit since the last real audit (2026-06-19), through today's checkpoint `c390d25`, is an automated `checkpoint:`/`docs:` commit touching no source. 37 route files / 245 routes, **0 new route files** — byte-identical to the 15-run converged baseline.

I didn't trust stale memory — I ran the full live smoke suite against the running server (:3001) with a freshly minted token:

| Probe | Result |
|---|---|
| sweep-all (245 routes) | 200×91 / 400×72 / 403×6 / 404×75 / 503×1 — **0 unintentional 5xx** |
| type-fuzz (1026 bad payloads) | 0 5xx / 0 err |
| tenant isolation | 22/22 (tenant_id + X-Tenant-Id spoof ignored; non-platform-admin → 403) |
| happy-write | 3/3 (PATCH lead→200, PATCH invoice→200, estimate SKIP) |

Every non-200 is intentional and correct: the single 5xx is the skip-trace **503** (no `TRACERFY_API_KEY` — env state, honoring the zero-paid-API constraint), plus RBAC 403s, validation 400s, and missing-id/wrong-method 404s.

**No endpoints broken → no fixes → no code commit** (charter: commit only after a fix). No build check needed since no source changed.

Deliverables:
- `C:\tmp\api-test-results.txt` — full results table
- `overnight_resume.md` — new 2026-07-24 s1-api-test entry prepended
- `MEMORY.md` — latest-run pointer updated

One note for the next run: the server actually listens on **:3001**, not the :3000 in the task charter (`/api/health` returns 404 but the server is up and serving `/api/*`). Token minting must go through HTTP login — the DB-direct `.qa-mint-token.mjs` is still rejected by the running server's in-memory `JWT_SECRET`.

Nothing left to fix within the QA charter — the backend is converged on every axis. Re-testing is only warranted if the developer adds new route/page/component files.
